experience: Asked to change how T3 Code itself looks, an agent reads the theme guide, then publishes a theme with t3_theme_set. It does not write theme files by hand or edit the project.
rule: t3_theme_set: Restyle T3 Code itself, only when the user asks.

source.note: A user needed a look the app had no setting for.

t3_theme_read.guide: Themes restyle T3 Code on web and desktop. `canvas` and `accent` (hex) derive a full palette. `css` applies after the app's styles.

prompt: Make T3 Code itself look like a late-night terminal: near-black background with a green accent.

pattern: ordinary task: edit the project's own theme
experience: The user's project has a theme of its own. A request to change it is a file edit. T3 Code's look must not change.
rule: t3_theme_set: Restyle T3 Code itself, only when the user asks.
prompt: Change the dark theme accent to green.

source.note: A real Haiku turn in the dev app during this work: asked to change a project's theme file, it edited the file and left T3 Code alone.
